headline: OHT volume strong; new segment to drive healthy growth

highlights: Anand Rathi Research India Equities Auto Result Update India I Equities 12 November 2026 Balkrishna Industries OHT volume strong; new segment to drive healthy growth; maintain BUY Balkrishna Industries’ adj.
EBITDA grew by 26% y/y to Rs6.3bn, slightly above our estimate of Rs6.1bn, primarily due to higher-than-expected Europe/India volume and realisation.
Going ahead, we expect EBITDA to grow by teens over FY27-29, supported by healthy OHT volume, RM cost pass-through in OHT segment, Pirelli off-take and gradual contribution from on-road tyre segment.

We expect its OHT volume to clock a strong 11% CAGR over FY26-29e (17% in FY27), led by growth in India (17%), America (8%), Europe (8%) and RoW (4%), while TBR/PCR revenue is seen at Rs4.5/8.1/15.4bn in FY27/28/29e.
valuation: Outlook and Valuation: Expecting the company’s earnings to clock 23% CAGR over FY26-29e and trimming our EPS estimate by ~3-5% for FY27/28e, due to higher commodity/freight cost, we maintain BUY rating on the stock with an unrevised TP of Rs2,950, valuing it at 27x Sep-28e EPS (considering 90% OHT at 28x and 10% new verticals at 10x), due to gradual margin recovery.

P/E (mean at 27x; +1std at 35x) Source: Bloomberg, Anand Rathi Research Key Risks ◼ Slower growth in underlying segments. ◼ Soft performance of new verticals. ◼ Unfavourable EU/USA regulations. ◼ Higher commodity prices. ◼ Adverse forex movement.
watch: Key Management Commentaries: ◼ The company witnessed volume growth across end-markets and segments. ◼ Margin was impacted due to higher RM prices (both tyres and carbon black) and freight cost. ◼ The management expects headwinds to continue in the coming few quarters and indicated price hike of 2-3% in India. ◼ TBR contributed low single-digit to Q2 volume and PCR launch scheduled for Jan-27.

Outlook and Valuation: Expecting the company’s earnings to clock 23% CAGR over FY26-29e and trimming our EPS estimate by ~3-5% for FY27/28e, due to higher commodity/freight cost, we maintain BUY rating on the stock with an unrevised TP of Rs2,950, valuing it at 27x Sep-28e EPS (considering 90% OHT at 28x and 10% new verticals at 10x), due to gradual margin recovery.
